messages:
incident_bot: [ALERT] p99 SLO breach on inference.streaming.tail - auto-created incident thread.
Service: inference-streaming | Environment: prod | Metric: p99 latency = 2.4s (SLO 1.2s)
Symptom: streaming tails frequently stall (clients see chunking + reconnects). Spike started ~09:00 UTC. Suspect control-plane dependencies (config fetch / auth tokenstore rate-limits). Paging oncall. :rotating_light:

alice: I'm oncall, picking this up. Seeing p95 ~600ms, p99 2.4s. Customers reporting long tails and some websocket reconnects.

ben: I'm looking at runtime side — no sudden GPU pressure, steady tokens/sec. KV cache hit rate dropped ~20% at 09:00. Could be configfetch or feature-flag gating causing extra roundtrips per request.

carla: Platform: configservice has increased 5xxs around same time, and we pushed a rolling rollout of a feature flag sync yesterday. Not sure correlation but will check rollout status and can pause.

ryan: SRE: tokenstore (auth-token) shows 429 bursts and increased latencies ~100ms->700ms on token validation RPCs. Rate-windowing kicked in around 09:02 for a few hosts. Also seeing a bunch of configfetch requests from inference fleet that look hot-keyed to a few config shards.

alice: Workplan: 1) immediate - enable config fetch cache bypass? no, better: throttle client configfetch traffic + enable fallback to cached config versions. 2) mitigate auth 429s - open temporary higher rate window for inference service clients. 3) longer - investigate feature flag sync rollout.

ben: I'll wire a temporary route rule to send inference.streaming traffic to cached-config path (force-local-cache=true) to avoid control-plane roundtrips. How to run:
```bash
# prod API gateway -> override header
curl -X POST https://ops-router/reroute -d '{"service":"inference","header":"X-Force-Local-Config:1"}'
```
Apply for canary first (10%) then ramp.

carla: Rolling back the flag sync job now. Rolling restart of feature-flag-workers paused. ETA ~4m. Also increasing configservice worker pool by 2 nodes (hot-shard mitigation).

ryan: I just bumped the auth tokenstore rate window for service-role=inference from 100rpm->1000rpm for 10m. Monitor for 5xx. Also added temporary extra tokenstore instance via autoscale group.

mike: CS: getting pings from 2 customers (internal tickets) complaining about long speech-to-text streaming stalls. No data-loss, but UX degraded. Telling customers we have a mitigation in progress.

alice: After first mitigations: p95 dropped to 320ms, p99 down to 1.1s. Streaming reconnects reduced. Still intermittent stalls for some long sequences (20s+).

ben: Observed interesting pattern: requests that hit a particular feature-flag evaluation path do an extra config fetch for rollout metadata; those are the tails. Adding a local short-circuit for rollout metadata lookup to avoid remote call. Patch in prod branch, will deploy to 10% now.

carla: Revert complete + configservice pool up + rollout paused. No new 5xxs from configservice.

alice: Handing off to eva for on-call rotation in 20 minutes. Eva, I set the mitigation runbook: cached-config routing enabled, auth rate window increased, feature-flag rollout paused. Watch p99 for next 30m.

eva: ack — taking over at 09:12 UTC. I'll keep the auth bump for now and watch for regressions. If p99 stays <1.2s for 30m, start gradual rollback of auth bump.

ryan: Notes for postmortem: root cause likely a combination of (1) feature-flag rollout causing hot metadata requests, (2) configservice sharding hot-keys, (3) tokenstore conservative rate windowing leading to extra latency under burst. Need durable fixes: cache rollout metadata, shard config differently, and tune tokenstore backoff.

mike: I'll draft a short customer-facing status update: 'We mitigated streaming stalls impacting a subset of customers. Root cause under investigation; background fix work planned.' Will share note once postmortem begins.

alice: Logs/snippets:
```
# sample trace for stalled stream
trace_id=abc123 service=inference.streaming step=eval_flag meta_rpc=GET /config/v1/rollout?key=feature-x latency=720ms upstream=tokenstore:429
# configservice errors
[09:01:12] config-service shard-7 500 "hot-shard overwhelmed"
```

ben: Followups assigned: ben -> code short-circuit for rollout metadata; carla -> configservice shard redistribution; ryan -> tokenstore rate-window tuning; alice -> coordinate postmortem + customer comms.

alice: Closing notes: mitigations visible in metrics. If anyone sees new regressions ping in thread and tag @alice or @eva. Will convert this thread to a postmortem ticket once stable. :white_check_mark:
